question: Under what procedural condition should one worship the mātṛkā according to this injunction?
premises: The object of worship is the mātṛkā.
Worship is enjoined conditionally by this method.
inference: If one worships the mātṛkā, one should do so by this prescribed method.
plain_english: O goddess, if one worships the mātṛkā, one should worship her by this method.
